minimalPairs.focus: 辅音连缀 θr 与 tr
辅音连缀 pr 与 pl
清音 s /s/ 与浊音 z /z/

sentences.text: I think this is the third thing I've tried today.
sentences.tipZh: 舌尖轻触上齿，气流从齿缝送出

sentences.text: Both of my brothers are thirty-three this month.
sentences.tipZh: th 别读成 s 或 f

sentences.text: The weather is warmer on Thursday than it was yesterday.
sentences.tipZh: the、this 的 th 要振动声带

sentences.text: I thought you said something about the north path.
sentences.tipZh: 句尾 th 轻收，不要拖音

sentences.text: Please bring the blue truck around the corner slowly.
sentences.tipZh: r 卷舌不碰牙，l 舌尖抵上齿

sentences.text: Really, Larry? You already read that long article?
sentences.tipZh: r 音圆唇，l 音舌尖抬起

sentences.text: I'd rather walk along the river than ride a bike.
sentences.tipZh: 对比 river 的 r 和 walk 的 l

sentences.text: We were very worried when the wind woke the baby.
sentences.tipZh: v 上齿咬下唇，w 只圆唇

sentences.text: Which van will arrive at the west gate at five?
sentences.tipZh: v 摩擦出声，w 不咬唇

sentences.text: Victor wants a window seat with a view.
sentences.tipZh: w 开头圆唇，别读成 v

sentences.text: This cheap ship trip is still a big deal.
sentences.tipZh: 短 /ɪ/ 放松，长 /iː/ 拉长

sentences.text: I need to leave this little list for the team.
sentences.tipZh: leave 拉长，live 短促

sentences.text: The fool pulled a full bowl of fruit from the pool.
sentences.tipZh: full 短 /ʊ/，fool 长 /uː/

sentences.text: That bad bed looks better than the red one.
sentences.tipZh: bad 嘴张大，bed 稍收

sentences.text: The cat sat on the cut mat and stared at me.
sentences.tipZh: cat 的 /æ/ 比 cut 更扁更前

sentences.text: Three strong students started their spring project.
sentences.tipZh: 三个辅音连读，别加元音

sentences.text: Please play the piano while I pray for good news.
sentences.tipZh: pl 与 pr 要分清楚

sentences.text: The street was crowded with strange, stressed travelers.
sentences.tipZh: str 连缀一气呵成

sentences.text: She spends her weekends practising spoken English with friends.
sentences.tipZh: sp、sk 连读不加 ə

sentences.text: I want to go there, but I can't find the time.
sentences.tipZh: 重读 want、go、can't、time

sentences.text: It's the best coffee I've had in a long time.
sentences.tipZh: 实词重读，虚词弱读

sentences.text: Could you speak a little slower, please?
sentences.tipZh: 请求句尾音上扬更礼貌

sentences.text: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
sentences.tipZh: was、to、but 弱读成轻声

sentences.text: My father and mother both love that thick soup.
sentences.tipZh: father 的 th 振动，thick 不振动

sentences.text: The little girl rolled the red ball really far.
sentences.tipZh: girl 的 l 与 rolled 的 r 对比

sentences.text: We've visited Vienna twice with our very kind driver.
sentences.tipZh: v 与 w 开头的词交替练

sentences.text: He shipped a sheep to the beach last week.
sentences.tipZh: ship 短、sheep 长，对比练

sentences.text: I'd like a glass of fresh orange juice, please.
sentences.tipZh: gl、fr、dʒ 连着读

sentences.text: I'd rather stay home tonight than go out again.
sentences.tipZh: rather、home、tonight 重读

sentences.text: Are you sure you want to try it again?
sentences.tipZh: 一般疑问句句尾升调
